name: Train Driver 2
description:
About This Game

Experience Polish railways like never before!

Welcome to Train Driver 2, a unique Polish railway simulator created by enthusiasts for enthusiasts, which will transport you right into the heart of the dynamic world of railways. Designed with online multiplayer gameplay in mind, Train Driver 2 lets you take on one of two key roles: a Train Driver operating the train, or a Dispatcher managing complex traffic at stations and posts. Feel true cooperation, where the dispatcher's actions directly impact the driver's work, and smooth traffic flow depends on your coordination.  

The simulator emphasizes high realism, offering faithfully recreated Polish rolling stock (electric and diesel locomotives, EMUs/DMUs), realistic, multi-kilometer routes, and detailed railway procedures. Immerse yourself in the depth of the simulation thanks to the recreation of specialized traffic control systems, such as SWDR, relay interlocking panels, and computer-based systems. Drive various trains – from passenger and fast trains, through expresses, to heavy freight consists, and even perform shunting operations.  

Not ready for online challenges? Practice your skills in offline mode. Want to leave your mark on the game world? Use the scenery editor to create your own stations – fictional or based on reality – and share them with the entire community.  

Train Driver 2 is more than just a game – it's a vibrant community of enthusiasts, a platform for learning about railways, and a chance to virtually experience the work of a railway professional. Join us and start your railway adventure!
short_desc: Polish railway simulator emphasizing multiplayer and realism. Become a train driver, operating faithfully recreated trains, or a dispatcher, managing traffic and signalling equipment at your post. Cooperate online, build stations in the editor, and join railway enthusiasts!
